Each handshake pairs one witch with one sorcerer, since there were no witch-witch or sorcerer-sorcerer handshakes. That gives 6 × 10 = 60 handshakes.

Solution A is wrong because it double-counts the witch-sorcerer handshakes and then subtracts for sorcerer-sorcerer handshakes that never happened. Solution B counts each handshake once, from both the witch side and the sorcerer side, and gets 60 both ways.

WINNER: B
